updatr, it was still build 1482.

I had verified my file integrity via steam to see if it would update the build and bring me to the latest version. That's what caused the black screen, probably?

Rerunning the file integrity check resolved my issue and revealed it was still build 1482. The issue seems to be resolved now since I can joinvworlds again but I'm not sure if this has happened / will happen to other people.

If you can provide a log file from when the error occured, we can investigate further.  Based on just this report and the fact it works for you after checking file integrity, I'm not sure there's much we can do on our side here.

The comments here don't allow me to post .txt files, and 48kb seems unwise to copy paste here.. details:
Upon starting VRChat, my vr headset spawns in a black world. The lasers seem to lag behind as if they try to smoothen the motion? The controllers shoot out lasers at an invisible UI, asking me to click 'Go' for my home world or to go to the default home (i assume, cause the ui is all one black void).

After clicking go, it shows the normal environment and starts initializing the world. It seems to get stuck there. On my overlay, vrchat shows a black screen. After about 1-2 minutes, I hear the error/timed out noise and I reconnect/get put back into the black void world, waiting for me to click the invisible 'Go' once more.

I assume it's build 1483: Yesterday I was on 1482/latest; but I'm unable to open my quick menu to check.

Edit: nope still 1482
title: [1482] Black screen on startup
